notes.title: What's Next for Neon Abyss?
notes.content:
Dear players,

I'm Lans, the producer of Neon Abyss. The game has been officially launched for 3 years now, I'd like to take this opportunity to chat with you about what the team has been up to recently and plans for the future. To give you a clearer picture of our current situation, I've summarized a few key questions that many of you are concerned about:

[h3]1. What is Veewo currently working on?[/h3]
    
We’re currently making a sequel to Neon Abyss.
    
[h3]2. What new content and features will the Neon Abyss sequel have?[/h3]
    
Firstly, the sequel will feature multiplayer. After a year of development, the multiplayer part of the sequel is now fully functional.
    
Moreover, the sequel to Neon Abyss will feature a completely new storyline, along with a wide range of thrilling new content. This will include challenging new bosses, each with their own distinct characteristics and interesting mechanics, a diverse cast of new characters with unique abilities, and a vast array of new weapons and items that will offer players even more opportunities to customize their gameplay experience and experiment with different play styles.
    
Additionally, we are working diligently to address some of the criticisms we received, such as excessive item repetition, lack of differentiation between weapons, and insufficient gameplay and content. The sequel will also introduce entirely new mechanisms and systems.
    
Keep an eye on our social media channels and website for updates.
    
[h3]3. Has Neon Abyss been ported to mobile?[/h3]
    
You may have heard about a mobile version of Neon Abyss. It is a freemium game called Neon Abyss: Infinity, that was developed independently by another company, using our IP under license. We were not involved in its development. Although it looks similar to the PC and console versions, the gameplay and mechanics are different due to the freemium model. As of now, we have no plans to develop a mobile game on our own. But if you are interested in a mobile version of Neon Abyss, feel free to check it out.


Our goal has always been to create great games and treat players with sincerity. We value all reviews and feedback, positive or negative, as they reflect players' expectations and attention towards us. Join our Discord (https://discord.gg/veewo) to share your opinions and suggestions directly with us. We are committed to continuously improving and growing.

We will give away free CD-KEYs for the sequel (to be redeemed upon release) to the first 100 Neon Abyss players with ideas and suggestions for the sequel in the comments.

Thank you for your understanding and support. We will do our best to create even better games.

Sincerely,
Lans

Abyssonauts!

The 'Lovable Rogues' DLC adds two bonus characters to give you some needed backup in the Abyss! They will join the eight other playable and unlockable characters to bring the total in the Grim Squad to ten!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7PjT02k.gif[/img]

Purchase Neon Abyss within a week from launch commencing July 14th and get the Lovable Rogues character DLC for free! After that, it will be purchasable.

Experiments of the Titan Corps, come defectors to Hades cause, these characters each bring their own unique abilities.

[h3]Saya[/h3]

Saya brings a few more splashes of color to the abyss and not just with her hair! She is a master sword wielder and will paint the dungeons red with powerful sword strikes. Switch between her katana and your ranged weapon in the dungeon to destroy any foe at any distance!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ejIIZKk.gif[/img]

[h3]Amir[/h3]

Subjected to awful mental experiments, Amir can muster the power of his mind to his advantage. They are able to ascertain the exact effect of items before picking them up. 

Each run Amir starts with 6 heart containers but lose one after each level, once hitting zero they are able to levitate! Be careful, Amir's only hope of survival is to collect shields!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dxdsvxD.gif[/img]

notes.title: Feature Spotlight - Everything Bosses!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Today we are showing off the bosses you'll battle in Neon Abyss! Each boss is a challenge but there's a few ways bosses can change as you get further through a dungeon run and as you start to evolve your dungeons.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gn2eLmB.gif[/img]

[h1]Double Trouble[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V4zQStC.gif[/img]

Each of the normal bosses have two versions, one for the earlier levels in your dungeon runs and then there’s the chance to battle their more challenging counterpart in the later levels. 

[h1]Managers[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zPktGTH.gif[/img]

Managers are particularly tough bosses that inhabit rooms at the end of a dungeon run. As you progress through the game and unlock more of these managers, you will be able to go through more levels on each run. Further managers will guard the next tier of these extra levels.

[h1]Upgrades and Items[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FfVG5ku.gif[/img]

Bosses are guaranteed to drop upgrades for you, your weapons and health to help face the next harder levels in the dungeon. Plus - will make you look more flashy!

That's all for this spotlight, thanks for reading, we hope you look forward to battling some of these bosses in the full version that you haven't seen in the demo dungeons!

notes.title: Feature Spotlight - How to Evolve Your Dungeons!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Today we are showing off the dungeon progression in Neon Abyss! The dungeons will evolve as you play the game so that every dive into the abyss is unique.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jcrxjJa.gif[/img]

[h1]How[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6BNASAl.gif[/img]

To evolve your dungeon, you will need to collect tokens, these are dropped by defeating bosses and can be used at the bar to purchase: items, playable characters, extra bosses, extra dungeon rooms and even mini games to appear in your runs!

[h1]Trial Your New Toys[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B9ceaEN.gif[/img]

When you first unlock an item, for the first dungeon run directly after, you’ll be able to start with it as a trial. Be sure to make the most of these, as next time you’ll have to search for them!

[h1]Mini Games[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aDBFkcl.gif[/img]

Unlock challenging mini games that can reward your less violent talents in the dungeon. Including this tough rhythmic piano game.

[h1]New Bosses[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gn2eLmB.gif[/img]

Even unlock new bosses to extend your dungeon runs!

notes.title: Unlockable Characters Spotlight
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We hope you've been having a blast run 'n' gunning your way through the demo's dungeons! 

In the demo you will have been playing Wade. Today we take a look at each of the unlockable characters which makes the start of each dungeon run unique.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34710243/2618289421fae0f83c8ac35501c31c2e23767977.png[/img]

[h1]Matt[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aTaHmw6.gif[/img]

Matt can dodge roll which evades incoming enemy projectiles whilst rolling you where you want to go.

[h1]James[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TAuNFia.gif[/img]

One weapon isn't enough for James and playing them allows you to carry two weapons at once!

[h1]Zack[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/A5035xB.gif[/img]

Zack loves his knives and is able to stab even when an enemy is out of his melee range.

[h1]Lucas[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PR4T0nc.gif[/img]

If you like explosions, you will like Lucas. He will let you place mines on a whim but watch out they have a random fuse timer.

[h1]Ming[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OR9wsjs.gif[/img]

Hatch them all with Ming! Start your run with two eggs plus have an increased hatch success rate with this character!

[h1]David[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rg0OBSe.gif[/img]

Items can be found in high places and David can get you there by inflating a balloon to achieve the power of flight. However, this flight is costly as you will have to pay 3 crystals to use this once in a room!

That is all of the characters we will be showing off today. We hope you are all looking forward to the release and are still having fun with the demo. Watch out for another spotlight next week here on steam.

notes.title: Pets - Collect, Hatch & Evolve them All!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

You will encounter many eggs whilst traversing the Neon Abyss which on pick-up will follow behind you in the air. Today I will shed light on what they do and why you should try to collect them all!

[h1]Where to find them?[/h1]
To collect eggs you will need to search the depths of the Neon Abyss. You can either pick-up the eggs from chests, loot rooms, the store or egg dispensers! All you need to do is walk over them and they will automatically add to a growing train of eggs and pets behind you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/13AI8KG.gif[/img]

[h1]Hatch them all![/h1]
Always check your eggs before buying them! Eggs need to hatch before they can blossom into a useful pet but they also have a chance to fail! There are ways to help ensure your egg turns into a pet - these include item pick-ups and even an unlockable character who will increase your hatch rate.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6RYZ78k.gif[/img]

[h1]What can pets do for me?[/h1]
Your pets have a huge variety of useful effects, some are very direct: shooting at enemies, blocking incoming shots and even collecting items for you! There are other more elaborate effects like turning spare hearts into shields however, I’ll leave discovering all of those for when you can traverse the Neon Abyss!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4yF27Ir.gif[/img]

[h1]Evolve your pets![/h1]
Your pets will evolve as you battle your way through the rooms of the Neon Abyss. They will get both an upgrade to their appearance alongside more powerful effects like shooting double the amount of projectiles.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vbxxXgZ.gif[/img]
